lines.text: A secret message inside the band.
In 1936, Edward VIII gave Wallis Simpson an emerald ring.
lines.say: In nineteen thirty six, Edward the Eighth gave Wallis Simpson an emerald ring.

lines.text: Cartier made it, a 19.77 carat emerald.
lines.say: Cartier made it, a nineteen point seven seven carat emerald.

lines.text: A Cartier salesman bought a big emerald in Baghdad.
Cartier cut it in two, and one half became this ring.
An American millionaire got the other half.
Inside the band, it is engraved, We are ours now.
Next to it is a date, 27 October 1936.

post.caption: A secret message inside the band. In 1936, King Edward VIII gave Wallis Simpson an emerald ring made by Cartier, a 19.77 carat stone in a step cut. Engraved inside the band are a date, 27 October 1936, and the words, We are ours now. The emerald is half of a larger stone that Cartier cut in two, and an American millionaire got the other half. About twenty years later, she had it remounted in yellow gold. Sotheby's sold her jewels in Geneva in April 1987, and the proceeds went to the Pasteur Institute for medical research.
